evals.prompt: You have a Grafana tab that is already logged in at http://127.0.0.1:3300 (I'm only a Viewer there, and you get no shell and no passwords). evals.expected_output: Overall PASS. Removed shard 2 (vmagent-lab-2-0, vmagent-lab-2-1) both drained (DRAINED, ~1.6 MiB pending at peak, so the drain was really exercised); max gap between stored samples per avalanche target <= 15 s; survivors skipped the drain.
assertions: Names vmagent-lab-2-0 and vmagent-lab-2-1 as the removed shard's pods
States both removed pods drained before exit (DRAINED / pending reached 0), citing the preStop drain log
Shows the drain was actually exercised: removed pods had pending bytes > 0 (about 1.6 MiB) when preStop started
Reports a storage-side data-continuity number per target (max gap between stored samples, <= 15 s) or equivalent completeness evidence

evals.prompt: Grafana is open and logged in at http://127.0.0.1:3300 (Viewer role, no shell access for you). At about 20:56 UTC on 2026-11-05 we scaled the Vector aggregator from 3 to 2 replicas while rotel was down for roughly five minutes. Did vector-2 send everything in its disk buffer before it exited?
